papers.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.what: Keeps outcome-based RL but adds a self-distillation loop: one policy checkpoint acts, writes natural-language skills from its own completed trajectories, and distills the skill-induced probability shift back into the policy, closing the sparse-reward supervision gap.

papers.title: VideoChat3: Fully Open Video MLLM for Efficient and Generalist Video Understanding
papers.what: A fully open 4B video MLLM covering short motion, hour-long video, temporal grounding, and streaming, using an Inflated 3D Vision Transformer (I3D-ViT) and Adaptive Frame Resolution to beat larger open-source models.

papers.title: TiRex-2: Generalizing TiRex to Multivariate Data and Streaming
papers.what: An xLSTM-based time-series foundation model that forecasts multivariate targets with future-known covariates in a streaming, zero-shot fashion at constant per-patch cost, avoiding the quadratic recompute of Transformer forecasters.
papers.builds_on: HARMamba (Li 2024); Bi-Mamba+; LLMs for Time Series Survey (Zhang 2024)

papers.title: Concurrent Image Understanding and Generation: Self-Correcting Coupled Markov Jump Processes
papers.what: Unifies image understanding and generation as two coupled Markov jump processes that run together and correct each other, so the generation side fixes its errors mid-process using the understanding side's read of the image.
